description_en: Modifies the bandwidth of an acceleration region of a basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用UpdateBasicIpSet接口修改基础型全球加速实例的接入地域带宽
kebab_example: aliyun ga update-basic-ip-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-set-id ips-bp11r5jb8ogp122xl0000 --bandwidth 2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateBasicIpSet

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the basic GA instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the acceleration region of the basic GA instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的接入地域实例ID
parameters.name: ip_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the acceleration region. Unit: Mbit/s.

The minimum bandwidth is 2 Mbit/s
parameters.help_zh:
基础型全球加速实例的接入地域带宽。单位：Mbps。、

加速地域支持分配的最小带宽为 2Mbps
parameters.name: bandwidth
